scripts.lint:js: files=$(find core business worker frontend scripts tests -type f -name '*.js' 2>/dev/null || true); test -z "$files" || node --check $files
scripts.cf:validate: npm run cf:validate:development && npm run cf:validate:staging && npm run cf:validate:production
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply ACTS_DB --local --env development
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply ACTS_DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply ACTS_DB --remote --env production
